# Uranus Enterprises

> Chennai-based technology and security services company (owner: Mr. Bharath). CCTV installation, biometric access control, computer & laptop service, networking/site works, electrical works, and home automation for homes, shops, offices and small factories.

## Business facts

- Website: https://www.uranusenterprises.in
- Phone: +91 98417 70013
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919841770013
- Email: support@uranusenterprises.in
- Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 9:30 AM – 8:00 PM IST
- No online payments — enquiries via WhatsApp, free site survey, quote before any work.

## Services and starting prices (INR)

- CCTV installation: from ₹12,999 (2 HD cameras, 4-channel DVR, 500 GB, free installation, 1-year warranty). Packages up to 12+ 4K cameras from ₹74,999. https://www.uranusenterprises.in/services/cctv-installation
- Biometric & access control (fingerprint, face recognition, smart door locks): from ₹4,999. https://www.uranusenterprises.in/services/biometric-access
- Computer & laptop service (repairs, RAM/SSD upgrades, doorstep): from ₹499. https://www.uranusenterprises.in/services/computer-services
- Networking & site works (CAT5/CAT6 cabling, UPS, electrical): from ₹1,999. https://www.uranusenterprises.in/services/site-works
- Home automation (smart switches, lighting, gate automation): from ₹2,499. https://www.uranusenterprises.in/services/home-automation
- Electrical works (wiring & rewiring, MCB & panel upgrades, earthing & surge protection): from ₹1,499. https://www.uranusenterprises.in/services/electrical-works

## Areas served

All of Chennai, with fastest response in Tambaram, Chromepet, Pallavaram, Velachery, T. Nagar, Anna Nagar, Porur and Adyar.
